host_note: The original Tahitian Spondias and Inocarpus records concern squared timber, not demonstrated attacks on healthy standing trees. The rubber-tree record also requires its collection method to be interpreted separately.
taxonomy_summary: Crossotarsus externedentatus (Fairmaire, 1849). Original description and historical taxonomic treatments are displayed with claim-specific source verification; provisional distribution and host assertions remain separate from nomenclatural decisions.

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus externedentatus
taxonomic_history.note: Original protologue directly inspected on 78 in the 1849-imprint separate; p. 51 in the 1850 journal. Both the 1849-imprint and 1850 journal appearance are verified; effective precedence remains unresolved.

nomenclature_note: Platypus externedentatus appears in an 1849-imprint separate (p. 78) and an 1850 journal issue (p. 51); the date of effective first publication remains unresolved. Multiple names placed under this species in the 2023 Palaearctic catalogue remain Pending as independent taxonomic synonymies. Crossotarsus formosanus is a project-merged but taxonomically contested historical concept. Crossotarsus formosanus Strohmeyer, 1912 (PLT_000008) is historically merged here under C. externedentatus, but the relationship is disputed. Beaver & Shih (2003:78) suggested possible conspecificity, rather than formally synonymizing the two; a subsequent Chinese Crossotarsus treatment retained both as separate species. The merge reflects a provisional curator decision, not confirmed synonymy. Type or diagnostic-specimen comparison is still required; hosts and distributions are not transferred automatically.
